annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a European Parliament and Council Directive on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to the measures to be taken against the emission of gaseous and particulate pollutants from internal combustion engines to be installed in non-road mobile machinery (COM(95) 350 final)
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a European Parliament and Council Directive on measures against the emission of gaseous and particulate pollutants from internal combustion engines installed in non-road mobile machinery (COM(95) 350 final)
annotation.venue: Office for Official Publications of the European Communities (COM documents)
named_instruments_referenced: UN-ECE Convention on Long-Range Transboundary Air Pollution
annotation.summary_en: 1995 European Commission proposal for a directive establishing type-approval procedures and two-stage emission limits (NOx, HC, CO, particulates) for diesel engines installed in non-road mobile machinery such as excavators and forklifts. Includes explanatory memorandum, cost-benefit analysis and technical annexes. Concerns environmental emissions, not AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes EC type-approval for non-road mobile machinery compression-ignition engines using an engine-family/parent-engine approach
Sets Stage I (1997-1999) and Stage II (2000-2004) emission limits staggered by power band
Requires engine marking, conformity of production arrangements and manufacturer reporting of identification numbers
Allows time-limited, non-discriminatory tax incentives for early compliance
Exempts armed-forces engines and permits limited end-of-series exemptions
